column3: NKJV has the future “you will ask,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has the imperative “ask.”
NKJV has “so you will be My disciples,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “and become My disciples.”
NKJV has “remain,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “be.”
Close to the Greek; NKJV has the future “will bear witness,” where the Greek is present (or imperative).
